purpose: Replace reliance on a single binary +/-10 kb threshold with a full spatial description of ARG-to-MGE distance. This is a STRENGTHENING analysis. It does not alter the frozen PRIMARY cohort, the portability classes or any existing NM result.

distance_convention_validated.test: recompute the nearest qualifying MGE distance from raw coordinates and compare to the frozen arg_mge_neighbourhood.nearest_mge_distance_bp column
distance_convention_validated.result: 16,303 reconstructed positive and 18,837 censored, matching the frozen column exactly; 16,303 exact distance agreements; 0 mismatches (0.0000 percent)
distance_convention_validated.consequence: the convention is confirmed: overlap is 0, otherwise the gap in bp between nearest boundaries, scoped to the occurrence's own +/-10 kb window

CRITICAL_STRUCTURAL_FINDING.finding: a BLOCK is a merged shared-context region that can be far larger than any single ARG's +/-10 kb window (block spans up to 62,349 bp were observed). A feature elsewhere in the same block can lie beyond 10 kb from a given ARG.
CRITICAL_STRUCTURAL_FINDING.evidence: 111 occurrences sit in an MGE-positive block yet have zero qualifying features in their own window; their nearest in-block feature lies between 10,231 and 16,931 bp away. 16,414 block-positive minus 111 equals 16,303 window-positive, which equals frozen class B exactly.
CRITICAL_STRUCTURAL_FINDING.consequence_for_this_protocol: distances are computed STRICTLY within each occurrence's own +/-10 kb window. Those 111 occurrences are RIGHT-CENSORED at 10,000 bp even though an in-block feature exists beyond the window. Using it would manufacture a distance the frozen design declares unavailable and would breach the +/-20 kb NOT EVALUABLE rule.
CRITICAL_STRUCTURAL_FINDING.why_declared_here: this was discovered during read-only feasibility, before any group-specific outcome was computed, and is recorded so that the censoring rule cannot be mistaken for a post-hoc choice

population.occurrences: all 35,140 PRIMARY chromosomal acquired-ARG occurrences (classes A and B)
population.sequence_availability: windows provide sequence only through +/-10 kb
population.censoring: absence of a qualifying marker within the window is RIGHT-CENSORED at 10,000 bp and is never assigned an exact distance beyond 10 kb
population.twenty_kb: NOT EVALUABLE; no +/-20 kb quantity may be reported

distance_definition.overlap: distance = 0 when the ARG interval and the MGE-feature interval overlap
distance_definition.otherwise: the number of base pairs between the nearest interval boundaries
distance_definition.circular: topology-aware coordinates; separation is min over the linear gap and the gap under +/- one replicon length, so the artificial linearised origin is never treated as a biological boundary
distance_definition.truncated: truncated-window flags are preserved and carried into every output row
distance_definition.scope: the nearest qualifying MGE feature within the available +/-10 kb sequence

endpoints.primary: nearest qualifying MGE marker of EITHER type (IS/transposase evidence or integrase/integron evidence)
endpoints.integrase_arm_is_secondary_because: its evidence arm is sparse (3,033 of 32,364 features) and NM-V1 did not independently validate oriT or every NON-EVALUABLE boundary

primary_unit_and_weighting.rule: each shared block contributes total weight 1; if block b contains m ARG occurrences, each of those occurrences receives weight 1/m
primary_unit_and_weighting.rationale: a block containing several ARGs cannot dominate through multiplicity alone
primary_unit_and_weighting.retention: the distance of EVERY ARG occurrence is retained; a block is never replaced by its minimum distance in the primary estimand

sensitivity_estimands.S1: occurrence-weighted; every ARG occurrence has weight 1
sensitivity_estimands.S2: one deterministic ARG occurrence per block, selected by the lowest SHA-256 of '<block_id>|<occurrence_id>|20260822'
sensitivity_estimands.S3: minimum ARG-to-MGE distance per block, labelled 'any-ARG block distance', which FAVOURS multi-ARG blocks and is reported as such

primary_groups.Klebsiella group: genus == 'Klebsiella', exactly as defined in NM-V4 and NM-V4C

groups_and_contrasts.all_other_species: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY unless a numbered amendment is frozen before their outcomes are examined

summary_measures.cumulative_incidence: weighted F(d) = P(nearest MGE distance <= d) at 1,000, 2,000, 5,000 and 10,000 bp
summary_measures.full_curve: weighted distance curve from 0 to 10,000 bp
summary_measures.restricted_mean: restricted mean distance-to-marker through 10 kb, treating marker-negative occurrences as right-censored at 10 kb
summary_measures.median: reported only if estimable before 10 kb, otherwise 'not reached'
summary_measures.auc: area under the cumulative detection curve through 10 kb, as a descriptive spatial-proximity summary
summary_measures.prohibited: no ordinary mean after assigning marker-negative observations a fabricated distance

uncertainty.procedure: resample BioProjects with replacement; preserve every block and occurrence belonging to each sampled BioProject; RECALCULATE block weights inside every resample
uncertainty.intervals: percentile 95 percent CIs for curves and contrasts
uncertainty.prohibited: occurrence-level binomial intervals as the primary uncertainty

multiplicity.correction: Holm across the two primary species contrasts, applied separately at each prespecified landmark
multiplicity.no_threshold_search: no search for an optimal distance threshold is permitted
multiplicity.hierarchy: curves and effect sizes are primary; p-values are secondary

required_interpretation.A: does the A. baumannii result appear across the distance curve rather than only at 10 kb
required_interpretation.B: is it concentrated at very short distances, consistent with tight ARG-MGE architecture
required_interpretation.C: does it remain after block balancing and BioProject resampling
required_interpretation.D: does it remain under the deterministic one-ARG-per-block sensitivity
required_interpretation.E: is it predominantly driven by IS/transposase rather than the smaller integrase component

stop_conditions: any occurrence maps ambiguously to multiple blocks
more than five truncated blocks are found
circular wrapping cannot be reconstructed consistently
frozen MGE calls or class assignments differ from their recorded hashes
the primary block-balanced weights do not sum exactly to the number of represented blocks
more than 1 percent of exact distances cannot be reconstructed
a post-outcome change to endpoint, group or threshold becomes necessary
amendment_rule: any required post-outcome change needs a numbered amendment; the protocol is never silently modified

audit/data/derived/pr_context/out/arg_ne.role: occurrence to block key; ARG coordinates, replicon length, topology, wrap and truncation flags

audit/data/derived/pr_context/out/mge_fe.role: frozen MGE feature calls with coordinates; the endpoint source, NOT redefined here

audit/data/derived/pr_context/out/arg_mg.role: prior per-occurrence nearest-distance column, used only to validate the convention

audit/data/derived/pr_context/out/determ.role: frozen cohort; supplies species, BioProject and class A/B membership
